summary: Iter23 SAWALI Forms enhancements (Lot B-2: 3 new field types + Print PDF + QR data) — BACKEND 8/8 PASSED + FRONTEND all critical testids confirmed live. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter23.py, ~2.6s): (A) /me/forms/{id}/upload — 200 on small file (returns ok/file_id/filename/size/content_type/public_url; public_url is reachable via /api/files/{id}.{ext} and serves the bytes); 413 on >1Mo (1024*1024+10 B); 400 on empty; 404 on unknown form. (B) PUT /me/forms/{id} accepts FormField type=table with columns=[{key,label,type}], persists 3 columns, GET roundtrip preserves columns[1].key='qty' & type='number'. (C) PUT type=file with accept='.pdf,image/*' persists. (D) PUT type=signature persists with required=True. (E) Combo of all 3 types on a single page roundtrips intact. FRONTEND PLAYWRIGHT (live, admin login w/ dev_otp captured): /portal/forms/{id}/edit — FIELD_TYPES select contains 'table'/'file'/'signature' (verified via <option value=...>). Selecting 'table' surfaces field-table-addcol-0 button (clicking it adds a column). Selecting 'file' surfaces field-accept-0 input. Selecting 'signature' shows no warning when only one. /portal/forms/{id}/fill — toolbar shows all 5 testids: form-reset-btn, form-save-btn, form-export-btn, form-print-btn, form-qrdata-btn (all OK). signature-field + signature-clear render. Clicking form-qrdata-btn opens qr-data-modal with qr-data-image + a[download] link (OK). Clicking form-print-btn opens new tab (about:blank initially, then doc.write is used) — content contains 'Imprimer' + canvas/img tags (OK). After saving type=table on edit, fill page shows table-field-* (1) + table-addrow-* (1); clicking add-row creates table-cell-* (1). After saving type=file, fill page shows file-field-* (1) + file-upload-* (1).
action_items: (LOW) The print-PDF tab is opened as about:blank then populated via doc.write — works in Chromium with popup-allowed sessions but may be blocked by stricter browsers. Consider using a real Blob URL or a /print/{form_id} backend route for resilience.

(LOW) /me/forms/{id}/upload reads the entire body into memory before length-checking; max 1 Mo so it's safe today but if the limit grows, switch to a streaming size check (UploadFile.spool + raise on overflow).
(LOW) Files collection has no TTL/cleanup for orphaned form attachments (submissions deleted but file_doc + file on disk remain). Consider a cron / on-delete hook tied to form_submissions.
critical_code_review_comments: FormField (server.py L7390): columns Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] + accept Optional[str] are correctly typed. PUT /me/forms passes payload.model_dump() through which preserves these new fields (verified via roundtrip). FIELD_TYPES python set was NOT updated to include table/file/signature — but it's not enforced anywhere (no validator on FormField.type), so it does not block the new types. Minor inconsistency only — recommend extending the set or removing it.

me_form_upload_file (L7583-7626): correct order of operations — read body → size check → form lookup → write to UPLOAD_DIR → insert file_doc → return public_url. Good: includes form_id in file_doc + uploaded_by_id/email + IP. Reuses the existing /api/files/{id}.{ext} infra for serving (no new endpoint to maintain). Bcrypt-style content_type fallback (UploadFile → mimetypes guess → octet-stream) is robust. ✓

FormEditor.jsx — FIELD_TYPES extended in array order; isSignatureUnique() flags duplicates across pages; per-type config UI gated by fd.type === '...'. addcol button data-testid='field-table-addcol-{fidx}' is only the index of the field, not the col — clean. ✓

FormRunner.jsx — TableField/FileField/SignatureField are local components dispatched via FieldInput. SignatureField uses signature_pad lib, stores PNG dataURL. FileField uses fetch to /me/forms/{id}/upload, stores {public_url,filename,size,content_type}. QR uses qrcode lib (toDataURL). Print HTML is built client-side and opened in window.open(). All 5 toolbar buttons + 7 new field testids present. ✓

(NIT) /portal/forms/{id}/fill — Print tab is window.open('about:blank') then doc.write — works but a /print/{id} backend-rendered HTML would survive popup blockers and avoid a flash of about:blank. Acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 17 new testids confirmed live (3 FIELD_TYPES options, field-table-addcol-0, field-accept-0, 5 toolbar buttons, signature-field/clear, qr-data-modal/image/download, table-field/addrow/cell, file-field/upload) + print-tab opens successfully with 'Imprimer' content

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates a single form per session via POST /me/forms (title='TEST_iter23_<uuid>') and DELETEs it on teardown via the form_id session fixture. Playwright UI test uses a separate form created via Python requests (cleaned up via DELETE after the run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter23 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter23.py (2 classes / 8 tests, ~2.6s). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter23.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter23.xml. Notes: (1) Single OTP <input> on the verify-otp page — fill the whole otp string into the first form input (not 6 separate digit boxes). (2) Don't use page.evaluate(fetch+r.json()) — axios's response interceptor is patched globally on window.fetch and consumes the body; use Python requests + a hardcoded form_id passed into the script. (3) FIELD_TYPES dropdown is a native <select> — find the one whose <option value> set includes 'table'+'file'+'signature' before .select_option(). (4) field-table-col-{fidx}-{ci} only appears after at least one addcol click — fresh table has empty columns. (5) The Print PDF button uses window.open + doc.write; capture via page.context.expect_page (not on('popup')).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. One initial test-script issue: page.evaluate('async fetch().json()') failed with 'body stream already read' because the SPA's axios interceptor monkey-patches window.fetch and consumes the response. Fix: created the form via Python requests outside the page context and passed the form_id into the Playwright script.
